text:
ankur: Heads-up: seeing KV pager thrash on long-context chat tests. H100 nodes spike in page faults and we see memory growth even after request end.

maya: Can you paste the perf trace? Is this the PagedAttention path? :eyes:

ankur: Short log snippet from the run:
```
page_faults: 120k
pager_evictions/sec: 430
pt_entries: 1.2M -> 1.9M over 30m
GPU: H100x4 (driver 55.105.17), no hard OOM but resident grows
```
Repro cmd: `tests/longctx/regen.sh --model star-8k --batch 4 --seq 32k`

ryan: On our A100 cluster we didn't see the same growth. Could be reuse pattern mismatch or PT stride assumptions. Any difference in kernel selection?

anita: I ran a heap diff. Lots of tiny PT fragments (~256B) never coalescing. Looks like split paths aren't clearing owner bits so free lists don't merge.

ankur: Perf top flame (condensed):
```
kv_pager::evict_loop 35%
kv_pt::split_and_insert 22%
kv_cache::try_reuse 18%
paged_attn_kernel 12%
```
Patch attempt: toggling `kv_cache.coalesce_on_free=false` reduces CPU churn but memory still creeps.

maya: Any quick mitigation we can ship? Maybe raise paging threshold or disable paging for long contexts? :thinking_face:

ryan: Temporary mitigation: set `kvcache.page_threshold=0.95` in runtime config (avoid early pages), and set `kvcache.max_fragment_age=60s` to force more aggressive compaction. I pushed a small flag patch: `kv/pg-threshold-temp`

ankur: Patch helped on throughput but still ~20% slower vs baseline. Need fix in page-table coalesce path. I'll produce a minimal repro harness and attach metrics.

infra-bot: ci: build 2345 finished for branch kv/pt-fix — longctx-thrash tests: 3 failing, logs at /ci/2345/artifacts

anita: I'll take the repro harness. @ryan can you add an nsight GPU timeline with `--trace-pagetable` enabled so we can compare H100 vs A100 kernel timings? Also capture `nvlink` counters if possible.

jon: Let's do a sync tomorrow 10:00 to triage and prioritize fix. Add perf dumps to the ticket and pin the failing CI runs.

maya: Also check whether quantization kernel selection differs (int8 kernels may trigger different PT lifetimes). I can run an A/B of kernel selection flags.

ankur: Thanks all — I'll upload the harness and a short tutorial to repro. For now leaving `kvcache.page_threshold=0.95` on the canary to reduce user impact. :thumbsup:
